unit.title: Using Materials
unit.blurb: Choosing a material for a job, and changing the shape of materials by squashing, bending, twisting and stretching.
unit.subject: science

O1.t: Choose a suitable material for a job and say why.

O2.t: Know that some materials change shape when squashed, bent, twisted or stretched.

sections.title: The right material for the job

p: We choose a material because of what it can do. A window is made of **glass** because you can see through it. A raincoat is **waterproof** so rain cannot get in.

lesson.q: Which cloth is best for drying a cup?
lesson.a: A towel, because it soaks up water.

p: We can change the shape of some materials. We can **squash** play dough, **bend** a straw, **twist** a towel and **stretch** an elastic band.
A stone or a glass will not squash or bend – if you push hard, it may break.

Which one can you squash easily?

req.prompt: What is happening to each one?

req.reason: Stretch an elastic band is stretch.

req.reason: Bend a pipe cleaner is bend.

req.prompt: Which word means: pull to make it longer?
req.reason: Stretch means pull to make it longer.

options.fb: Twist means turn round and round.
Squash means press to make it flatter.
